from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class PaperNode(BaseModel):
    """A single paper document, capturing its identity and its citations to other provided papers."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The full title of this paper as it appears in the document")
    cites_provided_papers: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of OTHER papers from the provided collection that this paper explicitly references in its bibliography")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    papers: list[PaperNode]
